title: Measurement v1
description: Typed primitive for any measurement. Replaces naked status strings ('healthy', 'ok', 'true', 'degraded') with a typed tuple carrying metric, unit, scope, referent, method, baseline, observed_at, and explicit does_not_imply. Liveness ≠ availability ≠ integrity ≠ governance ≠ readiness ≠ outcome. Without Measurement, 'healthy' is epistemically useless.

metric.description: What is being measured (tcp_connect, http_2xx, swap_used_pct, package_version, etc.)

unit.description: Unit of measure (ms, %, bytes, count, status_code). Empty string for booleans.

region.description: ISO 3166 or vendor region (e.g. MY, US-East-1)

window.description: Time window the measurement applies to.

referent.description: Canonical entity the measurement is about (subject identity).

baseline.description: What 'normal' looks like for this metric. Allows framing observed value as relative.

does_not_imply.description: MANDATORY for high-signal scope. Explicit list of what this measurement does NOT entail. e.g. tcp_connect=true does NOT imply application usable, MCP call succeeds, data fresh, governance healthy.
